items.title: Do Agents Really Do Better With TypeScript?
items.blurb: Type errors took under 1% of our coding agents' time. In three public benchmarks, TypeScript fixes scored no higher than plain JavaScript ones, and adding Sorbet or RBS to a Rails app left the solve rate unchanged.
